title: Lex Leosis' Latest Single, "Dangerous," Empowers Women to Take Charge
htmlContent:
Toronto-based rapper Lex Leosis is back with a new single, "Dangerous," that delivers an empowering message for women everywhere. The song celebrates self-confidence and self-assurance, urging women to step out of their comfort zones and embrace their power fearlessly.

"Dangerous" is a funky, girl-power anthem that perfectly showcases Lex's dynamic flow and acrobatic rapping style. With a gravely vocal delivery and an effortless command of her instrumentation, Lex's music is a breath of fresh air in contemporary hip-hop.

In the song, Lex encourages women to be loud, confident, and dangerous, knowing full well that they threaten the patriarchy. It's a message of empowerment that will resonate with women and non-binary individuals who have long been told to "take up less space" and "be humble."

Lex Leosis has been making waves in the Canadian music scene since disbanding her rap group, The Sorority. Her jazz/funk-influenced debut EP, Terracotta, caught the attention of CBC, Exclaim, Earmilk, and other notable publications. She's also used her platform to support other women and non-binary artists and creatives, making her a standout figure in the music industry.

"Dangerous" is a sneak peek of what's to come from Lex's forthcoming album, set to drop this summer. But in the meantime, the song is the perfect reminder for women to feel themselves, shake off the winter blues, and bask in the sunlight of their own power.
